company.name: San Francisco Salt Company
company.shortDescription: San Francisco Salt Company is a provider of specialty salts and America’s fastest growing salt brand.
company.description: San Francisco Salt Company is a provider of specialty salts and America’s fastest growing salt brand. Launched in 2002, the company was the founder’s entrepreneurial dream and today still embodies his principals of quality, value and customer service. The company is a major supplier of specialty sea salt, Himalayan salt, Espom salt and Dead Sea salt products, available in both retail and bulk sizes.
